title: DICTO Solids: Exact Geometry
description:
Exact geometry of the named polyhedra found or named by DICTO (artist, Osaka) in his published papers and the Kaleidohedra findings archive: 44 solids, among them the DICTO Ogdoecontahedron, the DICTO Hecatodihedron, the DICTO OG family, the DBT and OTT, the DICTO Jewel, the six DICTONIC SOLIDS of #48 and #51, the twelve solids of version 3 (#55, #56, #57, #59) and, new in version 4: Ganesha (#61 The Swap Rule: the Janus c/h tetrahedral piece of a squashed stacking, at the paper's Figure 1 parameters ACBC, layer spacing² = (3/4)(2/3), λ = 1/10; in ℚ(√3)), Shadow-17 (#62 Shadows of the Fourth Dimension: a new construction from a known piece, two J11, Johnson's gyroelongated pentagonal pyramid, glued on their pentagons, the equal-edged form of the 600-cell's outer edge-first slices; in ℚ(√5)) and Humpty Dumpty (#63 The White Queen 600-cell: the real 48-vertex cell-first slice of the 600-cell, a convex egg of 92 triangles with tetrahedral symmetry; in ℚ(√5)). Every coordinate is exact, in ℚ, ℚ(√3), ℚ(√5), ℚ(∛2) or ℚ(t) (t the root of an irreducible cubic, stated with its isolating interval), and also given to 15 decimals; each solid comes with its faces (consistently wound), f-vector, exact volume, squared edge lengths, symmetry group and the values stated in its paper, as JSON and OFF, plus a copy scaled to volume 1.

Also included: 6 packings that fill space and 4 published packings that do not, each with exact lattice vectors and exact placements of its pieces; and an inventory (index.csv) of all 137 rows of shapes DICTO has named, with finding number, paper, status (new, rediscovered or known), prior art and a universal number: established catalogue numbers (Johnson, uniform, Wenninger, Hart, Mosseri–Sadoc) where they exist, and DICTO's own permanent catalogue numbers D1–D86 for his new shapes, in order of first publication (version 4: D84 Ganesha, D85 Humpty Dumpty, D86 Shadow-17).

A standalone checker (check.py, Python 3 + sympy) re-proves every stated value from the data files alone: 1062 checks, all passing, including closed outward-wound surfaces, exact planarity, convexity where stated, symmetry, the non-convex keyed solids as convex pieces minus or plus Tricaps, and exact separating planes showing that the pieces of each packing do not overlap.

Shapes and names by DICTO; data built and checked with Claude (Anthropic). More at dictospheres.com.
notes: Version 4 (28 October 2026): adds Ganesha (#61, D84), Humpty Dumpty (#63, D85) and Shadow-17 (#62, D86), and the field ℚ(√3).
